    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersMaximus's bread and olivesWarm olives with orange peel, fennel seed and garlic, with torn rustic breadHow to make it300g mixed olives3 tbsp olive oil, plus extra for dipping1 orange, peel in strips1 tsp fennel seeds2 garlic cloves, sliced1 rustic loafsalt, to tasteWarm the olives gently in the oil with the orange peel, fennel seeds and garlic for 5 minutes.Tear the loaf into chunks.Serve with the olives and a bowl of oil and salt for dipping.Figs with honey and walnutsBaked figs with goat's cheese, honey, toasted walnuts and thymeHow to make it8 ripe figs, halved120g goat's cheese2 tbsp honey60g walnuts, toasted4 sprigs of thymePut a small spoon of goat's cheese on each fig half.Bake at 200°C for 8 minutes.Drizzle with honey and scatter with walnuts and thyme leaves. Serve warm.Elysium wheat field crackersHand through the wheat. What we do echoes in eternity.How to make itAs written, serves 4Thin wholemeal crackers baked crisp with olive oil, sea salt and rosemary, with whipped lemon ricotta and a pool of honey and chilli oil.Mix 200g wholemeal flour, 60ml olive oil, 1 tsp salt and 90ml water into a firm dough.Roll very thin, cut into long strips, brush with oil and scatter with rosemary and sea salt.Bake at 180°C for 12 to 15 minutes until crisp.Beat 250g ricotta with lemon zest and salt.Swirl 1 tbsp honey with 1 tbsp chilli oil over the ricotta.Roast chickpeas with cumin and saltProximo's ration for the new fighters.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsColosseum lambLamb leg studded with garlic, rosemary and anchovy, with tomato chickpeasHow to make it2kg lamb leg4 garlic cloves, slivered3 sprigs of rosemary4 anchovies2 tins of chickpeas, drained1 tin crushed tomatoes100g baby spinachStud the lamb with garlic, rosemary and anchovies.Roast at 180°C until 58°C inside, about 90 minutes.Rest the lamb for 20 minutes. Meanwhile simmer the chickpeas with the tomatoes, then stir through the spinach.Carve and serve with the chickpeas.Proximo's sausage, barley and lentil stewThe gladiator school in ZucchabarHow to make itAs written, serves 4Thick and smoky stew of pork sausage, pearl barley and lentils with onion, carrot, tomato and rosemary, finished with olive oil and parmesan.Brown 500g thick pork sausages cut into chunks.Soften an onion, 2 carrots and 2 garlic cloves in the same pot.Add 100g pearl barley, 150g brown lentils, 400g crushed tomatoes, 1.2L chicken stock and rosemary.Simmer 50 minutes, stirring now and then, until thick.Finish with a drizzle of olive oil, grated parmesan and crusty bread.SweetsRoman honey cakesRicotta cakes baked on bay leaves, drizzled with warm honey and poppy seedsHow to make it250g ricotta100g plain flour1 egg8 bay leaves4 tbsp honey, warmed1 tsp poppy seedsMix the ricotta, flour and egg into a soft dough.Shape into small rounds and set each on a bay leaf.Bake at 200°C for 30 minutes.Pour over the warm honey and sprinkle with poppy seeds.DrinksCommodus's spiced honey wineWarm red wine with honey, pepper, bay, saffron and orange peelHow to make it750ml red wine3 tbsp honey1/2 tsp black peppercorns2 bay leaves1 pinch saffron1 orange, peel in stripsPour the wine into a pot with the honey, peppercorns, bay leaves, saffron and orange peel.Warm gently for 15 minutes without boiling.Strain into cups and serve warm.
